newsitem.title: SPAIN: Three shot dead in drugs hit in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Three shot dead in drugs hit in Spain.

text.p: Three people were shot dead and a fourth was seriously injured in northern Spain in what is believed to be a drug-related attack, a local government spokeswoman said on Tuesday.

A gunman shot dead two men and a woman and seriously injured another person on Monday night at a boarding house in the village of Paredes in the Galicia region, the spokeswoman from the Pontevedra local government said.
Police believe the killings may have been a settling of scores between drug traffickers, she said.
